about: Every key, with a child's defaults filled in.
yaml:
pos: 2
projects: projects/
image: ghcr.io/example/clankos:latest
children:
  - path: responsibilities/employment
    remote: git@example.org:person/employment.git
  - path: projects/a/projects/b
    remote: https://example.org/b.git
    branch: long-feature
    skills-up: true
worktrees:
  - path: projects/fix/_worktrees/do-the-thing
    of: responsibilities/employment
    branch: do-the-thing
  - path: _worktrees/product
    remote: git@example.org:team/product.git
archives:
  - scope: "."
    kept: remote
    url: https://ledger.example.org/
  - scope: projects/fix
    kept: uncommitted
server:
  name: example
  mcp: https://pos.example.org/mcp
